title: Health Maintenance Organisations (HMOs)
description: Health Maintenance Organizations (HMOs) in the Philippines are private healthcare insurance providers offering policyholders access to a network of doctors and medical services. These plans, known for being both comprehensive and customizable, have an annual coverage limit. HMOs are frequently subsidized by employers and commonly form a part of employees’ benefit packages. As of September 30, 2023, there are 28 HMOs operating in the country, providing essential healthcare services to millions of Filipinos.
